subject: pol-dym
title: (R)POL.DYM.------TRS.
description: Chart 2 of 2 on book p. 409 (MID-W-3). POL-DYM (political dynamics) is the subject, with the (R) prefix, "the reality of"; TRS (transition) is the partner. From the subject: ALT-F (alternative functionalism) and DEC (decentralization). From ALT-F: CUL-TF-S (cultural transfer shifts) and GRAD (gradualism). From DEC: MT-TFS-AT (multi-transfer shift activity). From CUL-TF-S: RE-ST (restructuralism). From GRAD: DOC (documentation).
